hero.headline: About HotelMinds
hero.intro_1: HotelMinds is a hotel consulting company focused on revenue, profitability and sales for independent hotels.
hero.intro_2: Our international team brings together different perspectives from hospitality and the travel industry. Some of  our experts have hands-on hotel experience, while others have worked at leading booking platforms including Booking.com, Expedia and Airbnb.
hero.intro_3: Through strategic partnerships, we bring additional expertise in AI and emerging hospitality technology into our projects where it creates real value.

bullets.text: We focus on the commercial areas that have the greatest impact on performance. Everything else is secondary.
We don’t stop at recommendations. We work alongside the hotel to implement the agreed changes and turn strategy into day-to-day commercial action.
We turn fragmented commercial activity into clear priorities and decisions. The goal is to make it obvious what needs attention and what should happen next.
We work step by step with a clear plan and defined priorities. Progress is reviewed continuously and adjusted when needed.

founder.headline: Cristian Pop — Founder, HotelMinds
founder.text_1: Cristian brings 10 years of hospitality and travel-tech experience, including more than seven years at Booking.com, where he worked closely with hotels on distribution, pricing and online sales.
founder.text_2: He later moved into hotel consulting, advising independent properties on commercial strategy, revenue performance and distribution.
founder.text_3: Today, he and his team combine platform-side expertise with hands-on consulting to support hotel owners, operators, asset managers, investors and developers in building stronger, more profitable commercial structures — both in ongoing operations and during pre-opening.

finalCta.headline: Ready to Strengthen Your Hotel’s Performance?
finalCta.text: Whether you are improving an existing hotel or preparing for a new opening, we help you identify the right commercial priorities and put them into action.
